entities.name: Mário Júnior
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mario da Silva Pedreira Junior is a Brazilian male volleyball player. He was part of the Brazil men's national volleyball team at the 2010 FIVB Volleyball Men's World Championship in Italy. He played for Volley Piacenza. Mario in World League 2010 and Word League 2013 won Best Libero Award.
